Class ProductUsagePage

java.lang.Object
Manager.Page
ProductUsagePage
public class ProductUsagePage extends Manager.Page
Manager page showing how much of each inventory item was used in a date range, as a graph and a table. It counts what the Cashier deducts: recipes (sugar scaled by sweetness), toppings and one bag per paid order.
Author:
Brian Fu

    • USAGE_SQL

      private static final String USAGE_SQL
      Sums the inventory used by orders between two dates, one row per inventory item. It counts what CheckoutDialog deducts when an order is saved: recipe ingredients (sugar scaled by the chosen sweetness), toppings, and one bag per sale or return. Voided orders were never made, so they used no inventory. Items that were not used are listed with 0.

      Parameters, in order: Database.SUGAR_ITEM_NAME, Database.SWEETNESS_OPTION_REGEX twice, start and end timestamps, start and end again, Database.BAG_ITEM_NAME, and start and end once more.

      See Also:

  • Method Details

    • show

      public void show()
      Shows the date range, the unit filter, the graph and the table, then loads the default range. The date range opens on the Manager.DateRangeBar.DEFAULT_RANGE_DAYS days before the most recent order of any kind.
      Specified by:
      show in class Manager.Page

    • loadUsage

      private void loadUsage()
      Loads how much of each inventory item was used in the entered date range into the table using USAGE_SQL, then refreshes the unit chooser and the graph. Shows a database error if the query fails, and does nothing if the dates are not valid.
      See Also:
      • fillUnitBox(Set)
      • refreshChart()

    • fillUnitBox

      private void fillUnitBox(Set<String> units)
      Offers the units used in this period, keeping the unit the manager chose when it is still available.
      Parameters:
      units - the units of the inventory items used in the chosen date range

    • refreshChart

      private void refreshChart()
      Charts the selected table rows if any, otherwise every used ingredient in the chosen unit. Selecting rows in more than one unit charts only the first unit and switches the unit chooser to it. Shows a message instead when nothing in the chosen unit was used.
